Settings

Pointer

Soft cursor

Swaps the system arrow for a rounded one tinted with your theme's accent. Still an arrow, still tracks exactly. Mouse and trackpad only.

Sidebar Layout

You can also cycle modes with the layout button at the bottom of the sidebar.

Streaming

Network Filter

Sets which providers are prioritized, and which basic router Aeos uses.

Strict Sandbox

Blocks providers from opening new windows or reaching same-origin data. Turn off if a provider needs popups.

Typography

Select Font

Activity Providers

Route LuminSDK through Cloudflare

Try this if Lumin activities are blocked. It can also cause the opposite.

Cloud Gaming

Account

Not signed in. Cloud titles stream from a partner network, so they need a free streaming account.

Create account / set password“Success” creates the account only. Return here and press Sign in.

Create or set your password on the streaming network, then return here and sign in. Aeos cannot receive a login token from the external signup page.

Server Region

Required before a cloud game will start. Pick the one closest to you.

Stream Resolution

Higher looks better but needs more bandwidth.

Retry Busy Sessions

If a server has no free slot, wait ten seconds and try once more.

Show FPS & Latency

Overlays stream stats while a cloud game is running.

Music Sources

Celestial Instance

Serves audio for the Music page. Point this at your own instance if the default is blocked.

Default: https://celestial.press

Endless Radio: Deezer (beta)

Radio normally comes from Tidal's recommendations. The beta engine walks Deezer's related-artist graph instead, which never repeats and needs no cross-catalogue lookup. Either engine backs up the other.

Cached Audio Links

No cached links

Basic Router

Active router

No router — requests go out normally

Sign-up required

The only router that works on your filter needs an account and an API key.

Override router URL

Only needed if you want a different router than the one picked above. [url] marks where the target goes; without it, the encoded URL is appended.

Known routers:

Route Activity Lists & Images

Routes activity lists and cover art through the router.

Route Activity Content

Routes the activities themselves through the router.

Route Music

Routes search, artwork, lyrics and audio through the router. Routers cannot stream, so tracks download in full first and take longer to start.
